objective: Make the Cloud IaC cell-topology gate fail closed when a cell gitops_template omits or drifts topology-derived identity labels.

best_practice_sources.what_it_establishes: Argo CD Application manifests are Kubernetes resources with metadata/spec/sync-policy surfaces; this ChangeSet validates repo-local Application metadata only and performs no Argo CD API action.
Kubernetes labels are metadata for organizing/selecting objects, and automated components should use a prefix; this ChangeSet uses oyatie.com-prefixed local labels.
Kubernetes recommended labels show the operational value of consistent labels for application management while leaving custom labels to owners.
Cloud IaC remains anchored to the local OpenTofu registry protocol evidence chain already locked by prior slices; no new live registry operation is claimed here.
Repo-local doctrine makes Argo CD the self-hostable GitOps substrate; this slice strengthens local Argo CD template evidence without claiming runtime integration.

red_tests.summary: A fixture with a drifted AWS guest template cell-id label was incorrectly accepted by the cell-topology gate before the fix.

implemented_claims: The Cloud IaC cell-topology gate now reads each cell gitops_template file from the repo-local filesystem after path validation.
Each cell gitops_template must carry oyatie.com/region equal to cells.region.
Each cell gitops_template must carry oyatie.com/cell-id equal to cells.cell_id.
Each cell gitops_template must carry oyatie.com/tenant-id equal to cells.tenant_id.
Each cell gitops_template must carry oyatie.com/isolation-tier equal to cells.isolation_tier.
Each cell gitops_template must carry oyatie.com/default-cross-cell-traffic-allowed equal to cells.default_cross_cell_traffic_allowed.
The five live Cloud IaC Argo CD Application templates now include those topology-derived labels.
explicit_non_claims: No Argo CD API, Kubernetes API, kubectl, Helm CLI, OpenTofu CLI, cloud provider API, mesh-runtime, sharding-runtime, or network call is added by this slice.
No live Argo CD sync, diff, health, prune, self-heal, application-controller behavior, or namespace reconciliation is implemented.

No production authentication, Cedar policy runtime, tenant identity runtime, provider runtime, object-store integration, deployed endpoint, measured SLO, DR, capacity telemetry, or rollback evidence is claimed.
No tofu plan/apply/state backend, provider resource provisioning, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, production readiness, hyperscaler readiness, or cloud provisioning is claimed.
false_green_findings_closed: The cell-topology gate can no longer pass merely because a gitops_template path exists; it must also match topology identity labels for each cell.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed green.
Aggregate ./bin/oya gate run-all is not claimed green unless freshly rerun and proven.
This is a local template identity coherence gate only; live Argo CD/Kubernetes integration remains a future slice.
Cloud IaC still needs live object-store adapters, production auth/Cedar, OpenTofu plan/apply/state, deployed GitOps sync evidence, provider runtime, and FD-001 tenant workload dogfood evidence.

findings: Kept the implementation simple and fail-closed: read the existing template text and require exact topology-derived label lines rather than adding a YAML parser or live Argo CD dependency.
Strengthens cell identity coherence across topology and GitOps contracts before runtime fanout; this is a prerequisite, not a production-readiness claim.
RED fixture proved template cell-id drift passed before the fix; focused GREEN rejects the drift.
Operators and agents can see cell identity directly on Application metadata while the gate remains local and deterministic.
Focused tests, live gates, fmt/check/clippy, governance gates, and scoped Cloud IaC suite passed before closeout.

alternatives_named: Add live Argo CD API validation now
Use exact local label-line validation now
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Exact local label-line validation is the smallest honest step: it closes the false-green without adding live credentials, network calls, or a parser dependency.
rejected_reasons: Live Argo CD validation needs deployed controller/API credentials and runtime evidence outside this slice.
A YAML parser dependency is unnecessary for the current template convention and would widen dependency-seam scope.

findings: The gate keeps tenant/cell identity metadata coherent and continues to reject secret-like evidence refs; no secrets or tenant data are introduced.
The added work is bounded to reading five small repo-local templates during gate validation; no runtime serving path or network I/O is affected.
Cell/tenant/isolation metadata is explicit in local GitOps templates; regulatory-grade live evidence remains non-claimed.
Existing GitOps evidence and cell topology gates remain green with added labels; no template paths or Argo CD spec targets changed.
Mislabelled templates fail during local gate validation before a later sync/deploy path can rely on stale cell identity.
ChangeSet ties source/tests/templates, manifest, tasks, evidence, and audit-chain rows under Oya VCS lifecycle.
Used Oya VCS claim; avoided raw git/gh; re-read root hub and operating contract; kept /plan complementary-only; did not claim production/hyperscaler completion.
No new dependencies were introduced. Strict dependency-seam is part of closeout evidence.

review_findings: No critical/high issue found for the local gate scope. Live Argo CD/Kubernetes runtime behavior remains an explicit non-claim.
